title: Add Service toast with Undo; Remove until invoiced; no line is deleted
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the Maintenance Reminders QA build as an Owner/Admin (any user who can open Settings > Maintenance and create and edit work orders and customers).
  2. Open Settings > Maintenance. Open the schedule 'ZZAUTOTEST Highway Tractor PM', or create it with New schedule: add service 'PM-A' with a Calendar trigger of Every 6 months and canned lines, for example 'Engine oil and filter change' 0.8 hours, 'Chassis lubrication, 12 points' 0.5 hours, 'Air filter inspection' 0.3 hours and 'Brake adjustment check' 1.2 hours (4 lines, 2.8 hours). Save.
  3. Open Customers, open customer 'ZZAUTOTEST Fleet Co' (create it if missing), open its Assets tab and open unit 'ZZAUTOTEST 402' (create it with New Asset if missing). Open the asset's Maintenance tab. If the unit is not on the schedule, press Enroll in Schedule, choose 'ZZAUTOTEST Highway Tractor PM', enter a last service date for PM-A about seven months ago (for example 6 Mar 2026) and press Enroll. PM-A now reads Overdue on the Maintenance tab.
  4. On the customer page press New Work Order, choose unit 'ZZAUTOTEST 402' and create the work order (it opens as an estimate). Note its number, for example S3780-15904.
  5. On the work order page, find the Maintenance schedule card inside the asset card at the top and press Expand.
custom_steps:
1. Press Add Service on PM-A, then Add. Read the toast straight away.
  2. Press Undo on the toast. Read the PM-A row and the Lines tab.
  3. Press Add Service and Add again. Wait until the toast has gone, then open the PM-A row's three-dot menu.
  4. On the Lines tab delete two of PM-A's lines by hand. Read the PM-A row.
  5. Open the PM-A row's three-dot menu and press Remove. Read the row and the Lines tab.
  6. Open the Finance tab, press Create Invoice and record the payment. Then open the asset's Maintenance tab.
  7. On another work order where PM-A was added and which has since been invoiced, open the PM-A row's three-dot menu.
  8. After the Undo in step 2, hover the (i) on the PM-A row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • After Add, a toast reads PM-A added · 4 lines with Undo, and stays as long as the application's toasts normally stay.
  • Undo returns the row to Add Service; the 4 lines stay on the Lines tab.
  • Once the toast has gone, the row's three-dot menu offers Remove.
  • Deleting PM-A's lines by hand leaves PM-A addressed on this work order: the row still reads Added · 4 lines.
  • Remove does the same as Undo: the row returns to Add Service and the remaining lines stay.
  • Because PM-A was removed, invoicing does not list it in When was the maintenance done?, and PM-A is still due on the asset's Maintenance tab.
  • On the invoiced work order, the menu does not offer Remove.
  • The row's (i) explains it (in the design: “Undo and Remove take PM-A off this work order. The lines stay; delete them by hand if they are not wanted.”).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10572 (S16, The maintenance panel on a work order); Chunk 2 MR (Confluence 897679389) as edited 5 October 2026, S16; Design MR_V2_2 (Claude Design export, 6 Oct 2026), driven in full on 6 Oct 2026, Chunk 2 board artboard W2e; read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S16-R25: “After Add Service a toast reads PM-A added · 4 lines, with Undo, for as long as the application's toasts stay. Once it is gone, the row's three-dot menu offers Remove, for an Add Service made by mistake, until the work order is invoiced. Undo and Remove do the same: the row returns to Add Service and is no longer addressed on this work order, so the step after invoicing does not list it. Neither deletes a line. The lines already added stay on the work order, as any line does, and are deleted by hand, per S16-N4, because a line's own state decides whether it can be deleted.”
  • S16-N4: “Deleting the lines a service added does not unsatisfy that service. The advisor's statement governs, not which lines happen to remain”
  • Design, Chunk 2 board, artboard W2e, (i) on the row: “Undo and Remove take PM-A off this work order. The lines stay; delete them by hand if they are not wanted.”
